attributes.action: End MP accommodation expenses before cutting benefits
attributes.additional_details:
it is hypocritical for MPs earning substantial salaries to subsidise their personal housing and utility costs with public funds while simultaneously voting for austerity measures, benefit freezes, or welfare cuts that impact vulnerable citizens. 

Politicians should share the financial burden of the cost-of-living crisis rather than being insulated from the policies they pass.

Goal: Redirect the savings from reduced political allowances back into vital public services and social welfare nets.
attributes.background: A complete ban or significant reduction on Members of Parliament (MPs) claiming taxpayer-funded expenses for second homes, utilities, and daily living costs. It demands that these cuts be implemented before any further reductions are made to working-class, low-income, or disability benefits.

rejection.details:
We can't accept your petition because the Independent Parliamentary Standards Authority (IPSA) is responsible for deciding on MPs' expenses and pay. IPSA is independent of both Parliament and Government.

You can find out more about IPSA here:
https://www.theipsa.org.uk/
